text.en:
BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE No. S 41

CORRIGENDUM

BROADCASTING ACT (CHAPTER 180) In this Act, the following corrections are made(i) in section 15(l){a}, in the penultimate line, "there gulations" should read as "the regulations"; (ii} in section 37(5), in the penultimate line, the word "gulity" should read · as "guilty";

(iii) in section 58(1){a), the word "fish" in the first line should be deleted. Dicetak oleh AWANG MOHIDIN BIN HAJI DAUD, Pengarah Percetakan, di Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam. Harga B$5.00
